clips.title: The story
paras: South of the Crossroads, Sergra Darkthorn sends hunters to face the savage scytheclaws stalking the Barrens. Bring sunscale raptor feathers to their breeding nests, and prove your courage in a land that gives little quarter.

Sergra Darkthorn tests hunters against the beasts of the Barrens. After lesser trials, she sends you south of the Crossroads to hunt vicious sunscale raptors and take their feathers. Then you carry those feathers southwest of the Stagnant Oasis, into the heart of raptor territory. Placing them in the nests is the true test: it shows you can face the scytheclaws without fear.

Three raptor nests lie southwest of the Stagnant Oasis, near the Gold Road. Red, blue, and yellow eggs mark the separate clutches. Scytheclaws defend their nests fiercely against anything that comes near. Place the feathers of fallen raptors among the eggs, and you make your challenge clear to the beasts.

Return to the Crossroads after entering the nests, and Sergra can see you have faced the danger and lived. Walking out of a raptor den takes raw courage. The Barrens test every hunter; each fight may harden you, or leave your bones among the kodo ribs scattered across the dirt.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now, friend, the hunt deepens. Now you must defeat your prey, and then find your way to its lair.

Hunt the sunscale raptors to the south. Slay them and remove the feathers they wear. Place the feathers on the scytheclaw nests southwest of the Stagnant Oasis. Show their brethren you do not fear them!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been to the nests, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So you've been to the nests and placed the feathers of your prey within them. That took a fair portion of courage, no doubt about it.
Do you feel a little tougher, friend? Because you look tougher now then when you first came here. I guess the Barrens is doing its job.
